symbol_read — SYMBOL read_pod op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.symbol_read(image, reader='barcode1d', symbologies=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import symbolpod; symbolpod.symbol_read(image, reader='barcode1d', symbologies=None), registry से लेना हो तो opssymbol.get("symbol_read"))

• GPU: नहीं (केवल CPU reference implementation)

उपयोग

चुने हुए reader से image पढ़कर {"ok", "text", "error"} लौटाता है (table)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Read an image with one of the family's readers ("barcode1d" = barcode1d.read_barcode1d, "qr" = qrsym.qr_read, "datamatrix" = dmsym.dm_read, "zxing" = symzxing.read_symbols_zxing, optional extra, restricted to symbologies mapped by ZXING_FORMATS; its UPC-A answer is normalised to 12 digits) and return ok (decoded at all), text (None if not) and error (the reader's message on a no-read). A no-read is not an exception here — it is an outcome to be counted.

空の入力は ValueError(読み取り器の検査をそのまま通す)。拒否(ValueError): 未知の reader、2-D でない、非有限。
